messages.subject: vectorized cdfs
parts:
This email is mostly for Michael.

I've just added 3 parameter prob tests for cdfs. normal_cdf is the
only one that has been tested using it. Let me know what you think and
whether that's enough testing for cdfs.

See src/test/prob/distributions/univariate/continuous/normal_test.cpp

To implement one of these tests:
1) add a define for _CDF_
2) extend CumulativeTest. Define these functions:
- void valid_values(vector<vector<double> >& parameters,
vector<double>& cdf)
push back parameters and expected cdf values for the parameters specified.
- void zero_values(vector<vector<double> >& parameters)
push back parameter values that result in a cdf of zero
- void one_values(vector<vector<double> >& parameters)
push back parameter values that result in a cdf of one
- void invalid_values(vector<size_t>& index, vector<double>& value)
specific parameter values that should throw exceptions for the
default policy or errors with errno policy. This should match the one
defined for the log probability function
3) instantiate the tests. The instantiation looks something like:
INSTANTIATE_TYPED_TEST_CASE_P(ProbCumulativeNormal,
CumulativeTestFixture,
ProbCumulativeNormal);

The current tests are:
1) call_all_versions - calls the cdf function with and without a policy
2) check_valid - checks that the cdf function called with the
parameters specified in valid_values() returns the correct value
3) check_zero - checks that the cdf function called with the
parameters specified in zero_values() returns zero
4) check_one - checks that the cdf function called with the parameters
specified in one_values() returns one
5) check_invalid - checks that the parameter values throw exceptions
with no policy and errors with the errno_policy
6) vector_vector_vector - checks that the cdf value is correct with
vector parameters
7) vector_vector_double - checks that the cdf value is correct with
vector, vector, double
8) vector_double_vector - checks ... you get the point
9) vector_double_double
10) double_vector_vector,
11) double_vector_double,
12) double_double_vector,
13) invalid_different_vector_sizes - checks that the cdf function
throws an exception when vectors are mismatched in size.
14) matrix_matrix_matrix - checks that the cdf value is correct with
matrix<double, Dynamic, 1> parameters
15) matrix_matrix_double
16) matrix_double_matrix
17) matrix_double_double
18) double_matrix_matrix
19) double_matrix_double
20) double_double_matrix

The benefit of using the cdf fixture is that all of these tests get
run by defining a few parameters and values.

I'll put together the tests for agrad soon.



Daniel
